searchResults.jobSummary:
As a manager in the RTL/FE CAD team, you have the opportunity to shape the future of chip design and impact Apple engineers who develop the next generation of Apple products! You will lead a high-impact team that develops software solutions used by thousands of RTL design and integration engineers globally across all chip families (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and more).
In this role, you will be a key catalyst in transforming front-end hardware design into a modern, agile discipline. You will spearhead the transition to agentic workflows—redefining how RTL and integration teams operate in the AI era. This role combines deep knowledge of RTL/FE flows with modern software engineering practices, people leadership, and a transformative vision for engineering methodology.

searchResults.jobSummary:
Do you love creating elegant solutions to highly complex challenges? Do you intrinsically see the importance of every detail? 
Come join Apple’s growing wireless silicon development team!
As part of our Silicon Technologies group, you’ll help design our next-generation, power-efficient, system-on-chip (SoC). Our wireless SoC organization is responsible for all aspects of wireless silicon development. With a particular emphasis on highly energy-efficient design and new technologies that transform the user experience at the product level. Joining this group means you’ll be responsible for crafting and building the technology that fuels Apple’s devices. Together, you and your team will enable our customers to do all the things they love with their devices.

If you enjoy a fast-paced and challenging environment, and collaborating with people across different functional areas as well as thriving during crisis times, we encourage you to apply.
searchResults.postingTitle: ASIC Logic Design Engineer for Wireless SoC Group

searchResults.jobSummary: We are looking for a hands-on engineer to join our Platform Architecture post-silicon team. This team analyzes and tunes the performance and power of Apple Silicon for the Mac, and takes the learnings and measurements to drive SoC architecture change for future chips. If you work comfortably across the hardware/software stack, and the idea to bring up brand-new chips that just arrived from the fab does not scare you but gets you excited, when we would like to hear from you.

This role is for a Design Verification Engineer who will enable us to produce fully functional first silicon IP designs. The responsibilities include all phases of pre-silicon verification including but not limited to: establishing DV methodology, test-plan development, verification environment development including stimulus and checkers, test-writing, debug, coverage, sign-off for RTL freeze and tape-out.

At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet? Do you like changing the game? We have an opportunity for an exceptionally talented Design Verification Engineer. As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the rare and rewarding opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers every single day.

The position is relevant to all Apple sites: Herzliya, Haifa and Jerusalem
